*Kusalattika, Ācayagāmittika* (Patthana 17.9) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* division of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As indicated by its title, the text examines the relational conditions of states belonging to the triplet on the wholesome (*kusalattika*) combined with the triplet on states leading to accumulation (*ācayagāmittika*) within the combinatorial matrix of the *Paṭṭhāna* [SuttaCentral].
